## Summary

Describe the problem and the smallest coherent change that addresses it.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant targeted tests pass.
- [ ] The offline suite was run, or the reason it was not run is documented.
- [ ] No live service, model, browser, or cloud request was started by tests.

## Architecture and safety

- [ ] Core remains provider-neutral and routing remains decision-only.
- [ ] Public contracts and operator-visible configuration are documented.
- [ ] No credentials, model weights, logs, caches, or local runtime output are included.
